arabic text: ASSALAMU ALAL HUSSAYN, ASSALAMU ALAL ABBAS
english translation text: PEACE BY UPON YOU HUSSAIN, PEACE BY UPON YOU ABBAS

arabic text: JAB BHI GAYA ME KARBOBALA, EK HUJOOM THA LOGO KA
english translation text: WHENEVER I WENT TO KARBALA, I SAW A CROWD OF PEOPLE

arabic text: JAGTI AANKHON SE MAINE, JANNAT KA MANZAR DEKHA
english translation text: WITH MY EYES I WITNESSED, THE PICTURE OF THE HEAVENS

arabic text: SAJDA SARE BAYNUL HARMAIN, KARTE HUWE YEH DIL NE KAHA
english translation text: WHILST PROSTRATING IN BAYNUL HARAMAIN, MY HEART CALLED OUT AND SAID

arabic text: EK WAQAAR E PAYGHAMBAR, EK BANI HASHIM KA QAMAR
english translation text: ONE IS THE PRIDE OF THE PROPHETS, ONE IS THE MOON OF BANI HASHIM

arabic text: EK SAWARE DOSHE NABI, EK ALAMDARE LASHKAR
english translation text: ONE CLIMBED ON THE BACK OF THE PROPHET (WHILST HE WAS IN PRAYER), ONE IS THE FLAG BEARER OF THE ARMY

arabic text: DONO MERE AQA MOLA, YABNA ALI YABNAZ ZAHRA
english translation text: BOTH ARE MY MASTERS AND MY RULERS, SON OF ALI, SON OF ZAHRA

arabic text: KARBOBALA ME DONO NE, KHOON SE HAI TAREEKH LIKHI
english translation text: IN KARBALA BOTH OF THEM WROTE HISTORY WITH THEIR BLOOD

arabic text: EK NE KATWAYE BAZU, EK KE GALE PE TEGH CHALI
english translation text: ONE'S ARMS WERE SEVERED, ONE'S NECK WAS STRUCK

arabic text: DEEN E RASOOL E HAQ KE LIYE, JAAN HAI KI DONO NE FIDA
english translation text: FOR THE RELIGION OF THE RIGHTFUL PROPHET, BOTH HAVE SACRIFICED THEIR LIVES

arabic text: SHAAME GHARIBAAN AA POHNCHI, AALE MOHAMED THE QAIDI
english translation text: SHAM E GHAREEBAN WAS UPON THEM, THE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD (SAW) BECAME PRISONERS

arabic text: EK BEHAN PABANDE RASAN, THAME ALAM KO ROTI HUWI
english translation text: ONE SISTER WAS TIED WITH ROPES, HOLDING THE FLAG, CRYING

arabic text: BHAYI KE LASHON PER AAKAR, PARHTI RAHI YEHI NOHA
english translation text: SHE CAME TO HER BROTHERS BODIES, AND IN LAMENTATION SHE SAID...

arabic text: EK THA SAR NEZE PE RUKA, EK MUSALSAL GIRTA RAHA
english translation text: ONE HEAD WAS FIXATED ON THE SPEAR, WHILST ONE KEPT FALLING OFF THE SPEAR CONTINUALLY

arabic text: SAATH JO QAIDI CHALTA THA, KARTA RAHA HAR DAM GIRYA
english translation text: AS THE PRISONER WAS WALKING ALONG, HE CONTINUED TO WEEP AND LAMENT

arabic text: KHOON THA JARI AANKHON SE, DETE THE SAJJAD SADAA
english translation text: HIS EYES CRIED TEARS OF BLOOD, SAJJAD WOULD CALL OUT...

arabic text: EK WOH BACHI MASOOMA, NAAM SAKINA THA JISKA
english translation text: ONE INNOCENT YOUNG GIRL, WHOSE NAME WAS SAKINA (AS)

arabic text: KEHTI THI AAJAWO CHACHA, AAO MERE PYAARE BABA
english translation text: SHE KEPT SAYING, COME BACK O' UNCLE, COME BACK MY BELOVED FATHER

arabic text: JAB BHI TAMACHA USKO LAGA, KEHKE YEHI ROYI DUKHYA
english translation text: WHENEVER SHE WAS SLAPPED, SHE WOULD CRY OUT AND SAY...

arabic text: FAKHR HAI YEH SALMAN O KARIM, HUM KO MILA YEH SHARF AZEEM
english translation text: ‘SALMAN AND KARIM’, WE ARE PROUD THAT WE HAVE ATTAINED THIS HONOUR

arabic text: DONO KE DAR CHOOME HAI, HAI YEH ATA E RABBE RAHEEM
english translation text: WE HAVE KISSED THE DOOR OF BOTH THEIR SHRINES, THIS IS A BLESSING FROM THE MERCIFUL LORD

arabic text: SAANSON ME AUR DADHKAN ME, SHAMIL HAI YEHI JUMLA
english translation text: IN OUR BREATH, AND IN OUR HEARTBEAT; THIS STATEMENT IS ALWAYS PRESENT
